reviews.title: NEW VERSION = DUMPSTER FIRE!
reviews.text:
This used to be a somewhat useful scanner app…until they updated the definition of the word “free”.

The app is not free, it is the classic “hope this idiot user forgets that that they signed up for our trash app and pays us $7.99 a month until they die!”, kind of free. I can almost hear the snickering of some total nerd/weasels now, laughing about how much money they could leech off of their users.

Bottom line, your app blows. All you’ve done is applied an incredibly simple interface over the free (actually free!) chatter of hardworking first responders. You should be awarded approximately ZERO dollars for that, so I plan on paying you just that…thanks for destroying your own app, so I never have to watch some awful banner ads about some equally dorky game scroll down my screen, or squint my eyes real hard to locate a tiny “x” in the corner that’s nearly impossible to tap. Your apps embodies everything that is wrong generally with apps, the internet or even just humanity!

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: I just read a review from the developer that blamed areas not providing scans anymore because of their desire to protect communications (public,ICE, etc) on not having quality community volunteers. No, that would mean your community DOES HAVE quality community volunteers! Everything should not be and IS NOT public knowledge! Also, be careful because you can easily purchase a subscription to this app without complete knowledge. There will be no confirmation of the purchase ANYWHERE after a popup is presented that you cannot exit out of and no way to cancel or even find the subscription on your scanner app. I found the charge pending as verification I did purchase it.
